title: Research Data for Query-Local Hierarchical Visibility Graphs with Phased Adjacency for Geometry-Derived Maritime Route Construction
description: Route-level, validation, sensitivity, and performance data supporting the evaluation of query-local hierarchical visibility graphs for constructing maritime routes from polygonal water-domain geometry.

creators.name: Rakha, Hesham A.
creators.affiliation: Virginia Tech Transportation Institute and Charles E. Via, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Virginia Tech

references: Aredah, A. and Rakha, H. A. Query-Local Hierarchical Visibility Graphs with Phased Adjacency for Geometry-Derived Maritime Route Construction.
